== English Virtual Original comparison ==
The full early override has ‘Deploys -2 on Rogue 1’ and no attrition immunity. The later sheet removes that deployment discount and prints ‘Immune to attrition < 3.’ Pilot rating 3, maneuver +2 on Rogue 1, two fallback destinies and the once-per-control-phase singular take remain.
